scoring_justification: Recompute amplitude, harmonic ratio, CDW, saturation, and critical field from the raw JSON artifacts and compare to the paper's reported values with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden target values for Cr SDW envelope amplitude, harmonic ratio, CDW amplitude, FeRh saturation magnetization, and critical field
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.4 and text: Cr SDW max amplitude 0.38 μB/atom, third/first ratio 0.021, CDW amplitude 0.0068 electrons/atom; FeRh magnetization case a in Fig.7: saturation 4.2 μB/f.u., critical field ~0.03 μ_B H/Δ.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper's reported figures and explicit numerical values in the text.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual values reported in the paper for the specified parameters, used as hidden gold for result-level comparison.

required.planes: array of objects with plane_index (integer) and magnetic_moment_mub (float)

outputs.description: Self-consistent Cr SDW envelope (magnetic moment per plane), harmonic content, and charge density wave amplitude.

required.magnetization_curve: array of objects with field_mub_H_over_Delta (float) and magnetization_mub_per_fu (float)

outputs.description: Magnetization per formula unit of FeRh as a function of external field at T=0, obtained from self-consistent torque balance.

output_contract.notes: All energies and fields are expressed in units of the virtual level half-width Δ. The agent must implement the self-consistent solver from the paper's formalism and produce the stated JSON artifacts; the checker compares key features (envelope, harmonic ratio, CDW amplitude, saturation magnetization, critical field, curve shape) against hidden paper-reported values with suitable tolerances.

steps.description: Maximum absolute magnetic moment per plane should be close to 0.38 μB.
Ratio of third to first harmonic amplitude must be ~0.021.
Saturation magnetization should be ~4.2 μB per formula unit.
Critical field where magnetization reaches saturation should be ~0.03 μ_B H/Δ.
Magnetization curve must be monotonic increasing.
Magnetization at zero field should be close to zero.
